verdict.rationale: A live probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at https://docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). The docs also describe a REST API reference covering the entire platform, which the CLI and SDK are built on. missing for 10: evidence on the spec's completeness and coverage of all endpoints, a first-party doc page that explicitly advertises the spec download, and independent or community corroboration of using the spec.
